_comment_telemetry: The vc-fix self-diagnostics collector is deliberately NOT registered here. It ships with the vc-fix plugin (plugins/vc-fix/hooks/hooks.json), which is enabled at the USER level on the team's machines, so registering the .claude/ mirror as well ran TWO collector processes per event against the same .vc-fix/diagnostics/<sid>.* files — duplicated span records and racing saveState() writes with lost cursor updates (observed: two finalize records 12ms apart reporting 292 vs 290 spans). The mirror FILE stays (scripts/unit/mirror-parity.test.mjs keeps it byte-identical, and it is the copy a client-side .claude/ install would use); only the registration is gone, so this repo exercises exactly the copy a client runs. Trade-off: a checkout WITHOUT the vc-fix plugin installed gets no telemetry here — acceptable, since this repo's telemetry was corrupt while both were live.
